source_snapshot.items: UMC Uncorrectable Address Or Command Parity Persistent
source_snapshot.procedure: Inject d0/b0/s4/t4/m2 persistent fatal parity fault, recover/clear as approved, decode OOB CPER and reconcile available in-band -C.
source_snapshot.criteria: Mapped OAM, UMC, ext4 AddressCommandParityErr and Uncorrected system fatal severity; in-band agrees where available.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL generic review omits persistent lifecycle, clear and recovery.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; persistent mapping, lifecycle, authoritative clear and recovery required.

old_problem: Message-2 persistent fatal state has no source-defined lifetime, reset/power behavior or authoritative clear method. Without those core semantics, execution could repeatedly fault or strand the SUT. Insecure/max-ID evidence and generic DeepSeek review also lose lifecycle proof.
disposition_reason: Retain Pending and Source Conflict under ED-16/ED-18/ED-30. The command and CPER oracle are known, but safe Recovery is inseparable from the persistent stimulus: only AMD/FAE can define what m2 latches, what survives reset/power transitions, the authoritative clear operation and proof of clearance. These cannot be parameterized without a signed semantic contract. A gate-closed draft preserves full coverage and exact unlock evidence.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2078, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique-code result and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2079 / Wistron-AMD SVM-00123-V003 / 8600f0133ca8bb5f was directly read from XLSX and locked queue.
d0/b0/s4/t4/m2 and ext4/AddressCommandParityErr/fatal identify the intended stimulus and event, but do not define the persistent-state lifecycle.
Normal reboot, AC cycle or a guessed tool clear cannot be used as recovery; any may fail, destroy evidence or change coverage.
Completion requires proof of both system recovery and absence of the latched condition, using vendor-defined observation and clear semantics.
Complete persistent pre-crash/OOB evidence and one execution only remain mandatory; no reinjection or improvised clear.
No injection, amdgpuras, Redfish/CPER, crash/reboot/power/clear action, recovery, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Persistent fatal UMC parity lifecycle, clearance and recovery — BLOCKED DRAFT
test_case.purpose: After AMD/FAE defines the lifecycle, inject one persistent fatal UMC parity condition, prove mapped OAM/UMC/ext4 fatal CPER, observe the approved persistence boundary, clear it only by the authoritative method and prove healthy recovery with no latent state.
required_package: Signed AMD/FAE d0/b0/s4/t4/m2 target and persistent-state semantic contract
Authoritative persistence observation, reset/power survival matrix, clear command/sequence and cleared-state oracle
Compatible tools/firmware/Redfish/cdump schema and expected event cardinality
Dedicated non-production SUT, persistent evidence, independent console/power and rehearsed vendor recovery
Explicit one-shot authorization, quarantine and final-health policy
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED — DO NOT EXECUTE until AMD/FAE signs persistence, clear and recovery semantics. After unlock preserve persistent baselines and prove independent recovery, execute exactly one approved m2 injection, capture fatal/persistence evidence, recover and clear only through the signed sequence, then securely correlate complete OOB CPER and any surviving in-band evidence and prove the latch is absent. No guessed reboot/AC/clear, max-ID/plaintext shortcut or reinjection.
test_case.expected_result: Cannot be finalized until the lifecycle contract exists. After unlock, one injection must create the exact persistent fatal CPER and approved persistence behavior, the authoritative clear must remove the condition, and the SUT must recover healthy with no latent/recurrent fault.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS without signed persistence/clear/recovery semantics. After unlock, PASS requires exact target/event, observed approved lifecycle, authoritative clear with cleared-state proof and healthy recovery. FAIL on unknown/recurrent persistence, wrong event, failed clear/recovery or evidence gap.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until AMD/FAE signs lifecycle, clear and independent recovery.
Dedicated quarantinable SUT, persistent evidence and explicit point approval are mandatory.
One injection only; never improvise reset, AC cycle, clear or retry.
Quarantine immediately on behavior outside the signed envelope or uncertain latch state.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and signed persistent semantic/target contract
Version matrix, isolated authorization, persistent baselines and recovery rehearsal
Exact one-shot command plus fatal/persistence/console/power timeline
Paginated CPER manifests, secure raw/hash/decode and available in-band reconciliation
Approved clear record and independent proof latch is absent
Final health, no-improvisation/no-retry audit, quarantine/recovery and verdict
test_case.recovery: No generic recovery is safe. Use only the AMD/FAE-signed clear and recovery sequence after preserving evidence. If the latch, control plane or final state is uncertain, perform no further injection, reset or power action and quarantine the SUT until vendor disposition.

source_conflict.reason: Evidence transport can be repaired, but neither Master nor public rules define m2 persistence lifetime, clear operation or recovery; DeepSeek collapses this essential lifecycle.

blocked.reason: Static review and safe gate-closed draft are complete; execution awaits an irreducible vendor contract while historical BLOCKED remains unchanged.
